summary: Build a content strategy, editorial calendar, and reporting workflow with practical tools. Enrol for a five-day intermediate course.
lede: Content marketing and editorial strategy turns audience insight into a planned, governed publishing workflow. For marketing and communications professionals, the training covers audience research and content audits, topic-cluster planning, editorial calendars, and approval workflows. It also addresses SEO alignment, AI-assisted drafting with editorial review, and measuring performance through KPIs and reporting dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, edit, publish, govern, and report on content across marketing and communications functions.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with marketing concepts, brand messaging, and common digital publishing workflows. Experience using a CMS, spreadsheet software, and collaborative tools such as Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, SharePoint, or Asana will help, but no coding is required. The course is most effective for professionals who already contribute to content planning, campaign execution, or reporting and want a more structured editorial approach.
